title: Domains on Name.com's Core API; buy 1 to 10 years at Name.com's real total; Name.com's pricing guide followed
why: Jason, 2026-11-17: "add a 1,2,3,4,5,10 year dropdown like whois for domain purchases", and asked whether extra years cost the first-year price or the renewal price; he shared Name.com's Domain Purchase Pricing guide and Reseller Quickstart to check against. Each name in Shop → Domains has a 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 or 10 year choice; choosing a term asks Name.com's Get Pricing for those years (live and read only in a test) and shows the real total, our markup once a year; the term goes into the cart (domain_cart.years, one guarded column), the order, the receipt and the registration. Fixes from the guide: search and the sandbox check ask for registrations only (purchaseType registration: no aftermarket, expiring or backorder names); a standard registration and a standard renewal no longer send purchasePrice (sent, it must match to the cent, and a mismatch failed the order after the card was charged); new domains are registered with Name.com's own auto-renew off (we renew ourselves, the customer's card charged first) and an X-Idempotency-Key, so a retry can't buy twice. A Pulse retry registers the term that was paid for. FAQ: the cost entry explains terms. Jason, 2026-11-17: "need to address new api too." Every Name.com call moves from the legacy /v4 API to the Core API (/core/v1), the version Name.com's guides and its official SDKs (TypeScript @namecom/core-api 1.36.4, read for the exact paths and fields) describe: same hosts, same paths under /core/v1, same request and answer fields; the sign-in check uses GET /core/v1/accountinfo/balance in place of /v4/hello. On the Core API, autorenewEnabled sits inside the domain object. The storefront's own buy and renew (Domains::buy, ::renew; switched off today) get the same guide fixes: registrations only, no purchasePrice on a standard name or renewal (its renewal sent a price derived from ours, which would have failed after the business was charged), Name.com auto-renew off, an idempotency key. Not in this release: contact verification status on the Domains tab.

log.msg: Plan approved (no switch: everyone at once when published), advancing on schedule.
